ReturnNoContact2.name: Mario-sprite contact: stomp, kick, hurt
summary: Tail of the Mario/sprite contact routine (CLC/RTS at $01A87C is the shared 'no contact' exit).
$01A87E: contact entered; ignored while [$154C,X] is set, otherwise sets it to 8. A stunned sprite (status 9) goes to the pick-up/kick code.
Mario above the sprite and falling stomps it: bounce, points, sprite changes (winged to wingless, Dino Rhino to Torch), is smushed (status 3),
knocked off screen (status 2), or stunned (status 9). Otherwise it is side contact: a sliding Mario kills it, else HurtMario.
Parameters: X = sprite index. Returns: carry set when Mario interacted in a way that counts as contact.

SetStunnedTimer.name: Set stunned timer then stun sprite
summary: [$1540,X] = $FF for Goomba, Bob-omb, Buzzy Beetle and Mechakoopa, otherwise $02. Falls through to SetAsStunned.

SetAsStunned.name: Set sprite status to stunned
summary: Sprite status [$14C8,X] = 9 (stunned/carryable).

BoostMarioSpeed.name: Bounce Mario off a sprite
summary: Sets Mario Y speed to $D0, or $A8 if the A button is held. Does nothing while climbing. Followed at $01AA42 by the code for kicking and
picking up stunned sprites, key and P-switch standing handling (Mario standing on top, P-switch activation).
Parameters: X = sprite index (for the code after the RTL).

s01AB31.name: Push Mario out of a sprite
summary: Zeroes Mario X speed and moves Mario 1 pixel away from the sprite, depending on which side he is on.
$01AB46: gives stomp points and a sound according to the consecutive stomp counter [$1697] plus the sprite's own chain count [$1626,X].

s01AB6F.name: Spawn contact smoke at sprite
summary: Plays the kick sound and spawns a smoke-puff (type 2, 8 frames) at the sprite position in a free slot of $17C0-$17C3, if the sprite is on screen.
Called by the kick, toss and sliding kill code. Long routine (RTL).

DisplayContactGfx.name: Spawn contact smoke at Mario
summary: Like the code above, but the smoke is placed at Mario's X and Y + $14 ($1E on Yoshi). Does nothing if off-screen. Long routine (RTL).

SubSprXPosNoGrvty.name: Update sprite X position
summary: Applies the sprite's X speed to its X position by entering SubSprYPosNoGrvty with X + 12. Restores X afterwards.

SubSprYPosNoGrvty.name: Update sprite Y position
summary: Adds the sprite's speed to its position: low nybble is 1/16 pixel units in a sub-pixel accumulator, high nybble (signed) is whole pixels.
Writes the pixels moved to [$1491] so platforms can carry Mario. Entered with X + 12 it does the same for X.

SubOffscreen3Bnk1.name: Off-screen check, entry 3 (bank 1)
summary: Entries 3 to 0 set [$03] = 6, 4, 2 or 0 to pick which horizontal margin pair of the tables is used, then share the code of SubOffscreen0Bnk1.

SubOffscreen0Bnk1.name: Erase sprite when far off-screen (bank 1)
summary: Does nothing if the sprite is on screen or has the process-off-screen tweaker bit. Erases it if it fell below the level or if it is outside the
horizontal margin (checked on alternate frames with different margins). Vertical levels use the VerticalLevel code.
Parameters: X = sprite index; entry point selects the margin.

OffScrEraseSprite.name: Erase sprite off-screen
summary: Magikoopa is queued to respawn. Sprites with status < 8 or spawned at runtime are killed; level sprites are marked as not loaded so they
reappear when scrolled back. Falls into OffScrKillSprite.

OffScrKillSprite.name: Set sprite status to empty
summary: Sprite status [$14C8,X] = 0.

VerticalLevel.name: Off-screen check for vertical levels
summary: Erases the sprite when beyond the level width or outside the vertical margins. Skips the Net Koopas on alternate frames. Runs every other frame.

GetRand.name: Generate random numbers
summary: Updates both random bytes [$148D] and [$148E] by calling the generator at $01AD07 twice (Y = 1 then Y = 0). Preserves Y.
Returns: [$148D], [$148E]. The generator is a 16-bit-state LFSR-like step: seed1 = seed1*5+1, seed2 shifted with a bit-5 feedback, result = seed1 XOR seed2.

SubHorizPos.name: Mario horizontal position relative to sprite
summary: Y = 0 if Mario is to the right of (or level with) the sprite, 1 if to the left. [$0F] = low byte of Mario X - sprite X.
$01AD42 (SubVertPos): same for vertical position, Y = 0 if Mario is below, [$0E] = low byte of the difference.
Parameters: X = sprite index. Returns: Y, [$0F].

InitFlying?Block.name: Init flying question block
summary: [$151C,X] = (sprite X low >> 4) & 3 and the direction is incremented. Used for sprites $83-$85.
